streamAdmission: Pre-admitted unnamed connected AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM, descriptor>=3, owned CLOEXEC duplicate/nonblocking; no connect API; per-call MSG_DONTWAIT and MSG_NOSIGNAL survive caller alias flag changes; macOS additionally requires private DARWIN_MSG_NBIO=0x20000 in this feasibility candidate
limitations: Existing block reset still joins in MMIO; no production reset/recovery claim.
Transport reset may deliver/consume already-started owned stream bytes; authenticated generation/framing/credential protocol remains separate.
Before next encrypted run, block fixture must deliberately stall INSIDE perform; prior owned-completion holds are not blocked syscall proof.
Historical generic macOS epoll wait remains unchanged; only guarded-console lifecycle uses the timeout-honoring entry point.
0007 requested 5 ms lifecycle retry was not honored by the old macOS shim and is not established timing evidence.

Public MSG_DONTWAIT alone did not prevent full-buffer AF_UNIX send from blocking after alias mutation on this host. Private Darwin MSG_NBIO is a measured feasibility dependency, not accepted production ABI.
